refreeze.reason: Revision 3 correctly moved confidence to ARKitScenes raw, but the first attempted calibration join exposed a shape mismatch between CA-1M's oriented ARKit depth frame and the raw confidence PNG. The attempted output contained zero valid samples and no fitted model. Revision 4 keeps all eight scene IDs unchanged and adds ARKitScenes raw lowres_depth only as an orientation witness. For each sampled timestamp, the witness chooses the discrete dihedral image transform that best matches CA-1M ARKit depth; that exact transform is then applied to the ordinal confidence map without interpolation.

source.orientationWitnessRole: select discrete raw-sidecar image transform only; never used as ground truth or fitted error target
source.sidecarJoin: nearest same-video timestamp; CA-1M integer nanoseconds to ARKitScenes decimal seconds under a preregistered strict tolerance
source.orientationSelection: minimum median absolute valid-depth disagreement between transformed ARKitScenes lowres_depth and CA-1M wide/depth; p90 and valid overlap break ties
source.groundTruth: Per-frame FARO laser-scanner rendered depth registered to the capture camera from CA-1M
source.observedDepth: Per-frame onboard ARKit LiDAR depth from CA-1M
source.selectionPolicy: Three CA-1M train captures and five CA-1M val captures with distinct ARKitScenes visit IDs; scene membership is frozen before valid metric sampling.

rules.selectionRule: Selected scenes remain in the ledger even if difficult, sparse, partially invalid, or unfavorable. Replacement requires an explicit new split revision and invalidates inspected outcomes.

note: Revision 4 changes no scene membership. It records the lowres_depth orientation witness after the first confidence join produced zero valid samples because raw confidence and CA-1M depth had different image dimensions. No fitted coefficient or held-out outcome existed before this correction.
